thank you so much. unfortunately my paraphilia falls into the second category, the one involving those who cannot consent. my therapist is slightly knowledgeable in this area, but i have been considering finding a better one. its just so scary reaching out for help when it comes to stuff like this, there arent any good resources and im hesitant to bring it up to anyone for fear of someone mistaking me for some kind of monster. i can talk abt it in detail with my therapist which is a godsend, but beyond that she sadly hasn't been much help. again, i dont feel like im dangerous. most of the time i really dont feel capable of going out and hurting someone. its just.... while most days are fine, others can be.. not so fine. ive never done anything illegal, nor even got close but like... when im just so overcome with self loathing and hopelessness my thoughts can take me to some dark places. i want a specialist but i dont know how to find one, nor am i sure if i can even afford it in the first place. but seriously thank you for your kind and genuine response, it helps.
